# Member 3 Baseline Regressions (Univariate & Controlled OLS)

```{r}

analysis_data <- read.csv("data/processed/analysis_data.csv")

# Model 1: Univariate regression
# Looks at % of positive reviews and whether a game offers purchasable gameplay advantages to determine if those games generally receive lower review ratings.
m1_univariate <- lm(
  positive_pct ~ gameplay_advantage,
  data = analysis_data
)

# Examines the same relationship with added controls by holding other variables constant.
# Model 2: Multivariate regression with controls
m2_controls <- lm(
  positive_pct ~
    cosmetic_only +
    gameplay_advantage +
    paywalled_content +
    is_free +
    base_price_usd +
    log_reviews +
    factor(primary_genre),
  data = analysis_data
)

message("=== MODEL 1: UNIVARIATE ===")
print(summary(m1_univariate))

message("\n=== MODEL 2: MULTIVARIATE WITH CONTROLS ===")
print(summary(m2_controls))

```
